qrViewer.title: Open QR result
qrViewer.description: Load a patient's QR code and view the result in a large window.

input.heading: Load a QR code
input.hint: Drag an image here, paste it with {{shortcut}}, or open a file.
input.formats: PNG, JPG, WEBP, BMP, GIF, HEIC (macOS) or a single-page PDF
input.dropOverlay: Drop the image to read the QR code

qrViewer.pdfPageNote: The PDF has {{count}} pages. Only page 1 was read.

errors.title: That didn't work
errors.tooLarge: The file is larger than 50 MB.
errors.readFailed: The file could not be read.
errors.heicUnsupported: HEIC images are not supported on Windows. Please save as JPG or PNG and load it again.
errors.heicFailed: The HEIC image could not be converted.
errors.unsupportedFormat: This file format is not supported.
errors.decodeFailed: The image could not be processed.
errors.pdfFailed: The PDF could not be opened.
errors.clipboardEmpty: There is no image on the clipboard.

none.title: No QR code found
none.tipCrop: Crop the image to the QR code
none.tipLight: Photograph in good light without glare
none.tipResolution: Use a higher resolution, don't shrink the image
none.tipStraight: Capture the whole code, as straight as possible

multiple.title: {{count}} QR codes found
multiple.hint: Please choose the code you want.

text.title: Not a link – the QR code contains text

confirm.intro: Before opening, check that the highlighted domain belongs to the provider you expect.
confirm.blockedByMain: The link was not opened for security reasons.

reasons.insecure-http: The connection is not encrypted. Patient data could be read in transit.
reasons.credentials: There are credentials in front of the address. This is a common trick – only the highlighted domain counts.
reasons.idn: The address contains international characters that can look like well-known names. The technical spelling is shown.
reasons.ip-address: The link points to an IP address instead of a domain name.
reasons.no-public-domain: The address does not belong to a public domain, e.g. an internal network.
reasons.blocked-scheme: Links of type “{{scheme}}:” can start programs or scripts and are never opened.
reasons.invalid-url: The content is not a valid web address.
